channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Stockton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Stockton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on John Stockton
item.description:
“Stockton’s not really mentioned in the top five of point guards. He should always be in the top two with the things he’s accomplished.”

Jason Kidd on John Stockton, Dec 10, 2024. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Chris Paul, John Stockton
item.description:
“Yes, when you talk about Chris Paul and a lot of the great point guards in this league, to be able to stay up there . . . unfortunately, I didn’t play long enough to catch Stockton, but that number is very impressive when you look at not just the assists, but steals,”

Jason Kidd on Chris Paul, John Stockton, Dec 10, 2024. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Chris Paul on John Stockton
item.description:
With his third assist just 3:34 into San Antonio's 120-115 loss to the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday, Paul joined a list previously occupied by only John Stockton (15,806) and Jason Kidd (12,091).

“I remember the first time I played in Utah, and I looked up and saw John Stockton was the all-time assists and steals leader, and I was like, 'I'm gonna catch that,'”

Chris Paul on John Stockton, Nov 16, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on John Stockton
item.description:
“It’s something we thought of immediately when we put the team together because Steph is like the modern-day John Stockton,”

Steve Kerr on John Stockton, Aug 5, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Alex Rucker on John Stockton
item.description:
“There's no cause or connection between the pass and the basket and the majority opinion by a mile was, 'Oh no, that's definitely an assist.' I said, 'What?' [I was told] 'That's John Stockton.'”

Alex Rucker on John Stockton, Mar 2, 2024. Source: complex.com.

item.title: Alex Rucker on John Stockton
item.description:
“Went to the training in Detroit, part of this training, is they would show us video clips. They show us [John] Stockton to [Karl] Malone clips.”

Alex Rucker on John Stockton, Mar 2, 2024. Source: complex.com.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on LeBron James, Reggie Miller, John Stockton
item.description:
Mychal Thompson:

“We talk about it all the time. I say, ‘Look at LeBron James as an example.’ LeBron is going to be 39, but he has the body of a 29-year-old because of his workouts and his work ethic. Reggie Miller retired when he was 40. John Stockton, the same thing. There have been a bunch of guys that have played into their late 30s or close to 40 at a high level. Klay can do the same thing because his game translates into maturing well because he's a shooter. Shooters last a lot longer than guys that win dunk contests.”

Mychal Thompson on LeBron James, Reggie Miller, John Stockton, Aug 30, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on John Stockton, Darrell Griffith
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell told Andscape.

“I hold myself to a high standard. Now, other people may feel that it should. I’d be happy and forever grateful, honored and blessed for sure for that to happen. But I don’t think I’ve done enough in five years to have my jersey up there with Karl, John [Stockton], Pistol Pete and Darrell Griffith. I got a long way in my career to go to continue to be better.”

Donovan Mitchell on John Stockton, Darrell Griffith, Dec 19, 2022. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Michael Malone on John Stockton
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone said.

“I’m not gonna take a player and try to make him into John Stockton when he’s not John Stockton.”

Michael Malone on John Stockton, Nov 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: LeBron James on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Lakers'LeBron James on Jazz as last two all-star picks:

“There’s no slander to the Utah Jazz. You’ve got to understand, just like in video games growing up, we never played with Utah. As great as Karl Malone and John Stockton was, we would never pick those guys in video games.”

LeBron James on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Mar 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Georges Niang on John Stockton, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Georges Niang on the possibility of Joe Ingles passing John Stockton's Jazz 3PM record tonight:

“I say we don't pass him the ball. John Stockton's a legend.”

Georges Niang on John Stockton, Joe Ingles, Jan 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Karl Malone on Jerry Sloan, Chris Webber, John Stockton
item.description:
Karl Malone:

“I love Chris Webber but this was one time where I wanted to kick his ass. Right? So we had been wearing them out – at home – and Chris Webber started at half court looking for John Stockton. On the flip side, I say ‘Good on you Chris for studying the playbook. And we ran that four up and he didn’t even care. He hit Stockton right in the sternum with his elbow. I damn near felt it and [it] hurt. ...I felt so bad I went over to Coach [Jerry] Sloan and I said, ‘Coach, don’t run that again, please.’ Stock[ton] looked at me and said ‘No, I’m good’ and the next play– well, you know.”

Karl Malone on Jerry Sloan, Chris Webber, John Stockton, Jan 19, 2021. Source: The Players' Tribune.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on he and Donovan as a new Stockton and Malone of sorts:

“That’s the kind of legacy we hope to leave behind us when it’s all said and done. And hopefully win championships. It’s just great to have those two guys paving the way for us.”

Rudy Gobert on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Donovan Mitchell, Feb 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: DeShawn Stevenson on Jerry Sloan, Karl Malone, John Stockton, John Starks
item.description:
DeShawn Stevenson on his high-school-to-NBA transition:

“Mine was tough. I feel like I had to grind harder. I didn’t get the same chances as most straight-out-of-high-school guys. I went to a team that had been to the Finals two years in a row and was trying to compete for a championship and they had John Stockton, Karl Malone, Byron Russell and John Starks. We had seasoned vets, so I didn’t play that much. Also, I had a coach who was hard-nosed in Jerry Sloan; he didn’t play any games. I came out of high school and was flashy, so it was an adjustment. I kind of got stereotyped… It was tough, man. Sometimes I would get picked on really bad...”

DeShawn Stevenson on Jerry Sloan, Karl Malone, John Stockton, John Starks, Mar 19, 2019. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on John Stockton
item.description:
Rubio on having the first Jazz postseason triple-double since Stockton:

“Having my name next to his name is an honor. I don't know what to say. It's huge.”

Ricky Rubio on John Stockton, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“I always use Utah as a great (example). Thank God Karl Malone and (John) Stockton didn't listen to people, you know what I mean? They fell (in the playoffs), and kept trying and kept trying. And finally, late in their careers, they finally broke through to the Finals. They didn't win it (all). But you know, that's the pursuit. I just think it's so easy to (say), 'Hey, they should break up,' from the outside. And I think that's such an easy opinion.”

Doc Rivers on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Apr 17, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jason Kidd on John Stockton
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on John Stockton:

“If you want to help your guys at some of the positions, you find the best. I got very lucky John could join us.”

Jason Kidd on John Stockton, Sep 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Malcolm Brogdon, John Stockton
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on John Stockton helping the Bucks guards:

“We have Malcolm and Delly. And I told him we have a pretty big point guard, too.”

Jason Kidd on Malcolm Brogdon, John Stockton, Sep 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
“But on the flip side, if you're able to stay healthy, there's a level of confidence and relief that comes with having a ring already. Especially these days. There's such a burden and a stigma on players and teams that have not won the big one. You can name any of the above superstars. You see their name attached, whether it's Charles Barkley or whoever, [John] Stockton and [Karl] Malone, oh, they didn't win the big one. I mean, come on, they were some of the greatest players of all time and had phenomenal runs. But winning the big one these days, it lifts a burden.”

Steve Kerr on Charles Barkley, Karl Malone, John Stockton, Jun 6, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Gary Payton, Stephen Curry, Clyde Drexler, John Stockton
item.description:
“To me LeBron [James[ is still a young kid. I can't even fathom that this is [year] 13 for him. That's crazy to me. And having the generations that come after that. The [Kevin] Durant generation, you have the [Stephen] Curry generation. There's just so many generations in between that. So it's going to be fun for me to be around them. When I first played in the All-Star Game, imagine a 19-year-old kid walking into a locker room and there's John Stockton with his little itty-bitty shorts, still. There's [Charles] Barkley. There's Clyde Drexler. There's Gary Payton. As a 19-year-old kid, that was&.[wow].”

Kobe Bryant on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Gary Payton, Stephen Curry, Clyde Drexler, John Stockton, Feb 10, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Anthony Mason on Karl Malone, John Stockton
item.description:
Anthony Mason on Jan 23, 2015:

“I could get rebounds on anybody. As far as the toughest player to probably guard, that gave a little of difficulty, and it was maybe because of his point guard [John Stockton], was Karl Malone.”

Anthony Mason on Karl Malone, John Stockton, Mar 7, 2015. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on John Stockton
item.description:
Charles Barkley:

“You take Karl. Karl needed John Stockton. That's not a knock on Karl; it's just a fact. I could get mine any time I wanted to. So I'll say it on the record:I was better than Karl. Nothing against Karl. He was great. But I was better. The only thing he did better than me was score, and that came down to John Stockton.”

Charles Barkley on John Stockton, Jul 25, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Gary Payton on John Stockton
item.description:
“I always wanted to play against Karl and them, I wanted to play against John (Stockton).I didn't want to play with them and make the game easy. We wanted our own market.”

Gary Payton on John Stockton, Mar 7, 2011. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Karl Malone on John Stockton
item.description:
Karl Malone:

“No doubt. But a lot of people helped me get to the Hall of Fame. For me, everything had to totally fall in the right place.... I had Frank Layden dare to take a chance on a guy from Louisiana. I had to have Jerry Sloan as my coach -- to continue to run the [same] plays for 18 years. I had to have John Stockton to pass me the ball for 18 years. And also, I had to have state of Utah embrace me -- a black kid from Louisiana going to Utah. But the people of Utah accepted me from the first day.”

Karl Malone on John Stockton, Aug 30, 2010. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.
